statement: Revati's ruling planet (Vimshottari dasha lord) is Mercury; its presiding deity is Pushan (nurturer and guide of souls), symbolized by a fish, or a drum. It is traditionally associated with completion and nourishment, gently guiding a journey — or a cycle — to its close.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
